definitions: A compact version of the Foreo facial cleansing device, designed for portability and convenience.
A smaller, travel-sized model of the Foreo brand's skincare tools, often featuring fewer modes or a smaller brush head.
examples: She packed her mini Foreo for the weekend trip.
The mini Foreo is perfect for quick cleansing on the go.
Despite its size, the mini Foreo delivers effective results.
